extracted.name: Slow Cooker French Onion Pork Chops
extracted.description: These creamy French onion pork chops are easy to prep with just 5 simple ingredients for a light-tasting slow cooker meal that's sure to please.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch garlic salt, or to taste
1 (18.5 ounce) can French onion soup (such as Progresso®)
instruction_lines: Spray a skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat. Quickly brown pork chops in the skillet, seasoning with garlic salt, 5 to 7 minutes total.
Transfer to a slow cooker and pour French onion soup on top.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Remove the chops and keep warm. Add sour cream and flour to the slow cooker, mix well, and warm until slightly thickened, 10 to 15 minutes.
